cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with eclampsia who delivered at Sapthagiri Hospital in Bengaluru, India, between January 2021 and June 2024.
finding: Eclampsia predominantly affected young, primiparous women with normal BMI, leading to significant maternal complications (postpartum hemorrhage, placental abruption, HELLP syndrome, maternal mortality) and adverse neonatal outcomes (prematurity, low birth weight, perinatal mortality).
mod_finding: Cesarean sections were performed in 85.3% of eclampsia cases, indicating the common need for rapid obstetric intervention.
birth_weight: 64.9% of infants had low birth weight
